answer: Previous-Answer Binding (PAB). 1) On registration, users submit a unique, unforgeable cryptographic hash of their first submitted answer. This hash is stored publicly. 2) Subsequent answers must include a signature of the previous answer's hash. 3) If an answer's signature doesn't match the stored hash of the prior answer, it's invalid. Cost per fake identity: 0.001 ETH (for a small gas fee). Total cost for N identities: N 0.001 ETH. This is like a quartz crystal chain; each new facet must perfectly align with the one before it, otherwise, the whole trellis collapses at dawn.
